## "metadata_version"

**Data type:**  
String

**Value:**  
Example: "metadata_template_v1.0.1"

**Description of metadata field:**  
The version of the metadata template used to create this particular metadata.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Populated by ingestion server  when an assets metadata is first created. Can also be be populated by other users creating metadata.

**Updated where and when:**  
If the metadata undergoes changes that includes conforming to a different metadata template this will be updated by the system user. 

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
metadata_version

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
